AudiobookshelfBookProgressEvent.description:
Book-shaped counterpart to `AudiobookshelfProgressEvent`: identity,
acknowledged position/completion, and setup generation only, keyed by
`library_item_id` with no `episode_id`.

setup_generation.description:
Setup generation the acknowledged progress was produced under;
receivers discard progress from a stale generation.

cover_path.description: Service-scoped artwork identity (cover path, not server URL).

position_ticks.description: Playback position in ticks. Zero means start from the beginning.

AudiobookshelfProgressEvent.description:
Redacted, provider-qualified Audiobookshelf progress: identity,
acknowledged position/completion, and setup generation only. Excludes
API key, Authorization header, resolved source URL, and playback
`sessionId` — those never cross the ctrl wire.

setup_generation.description:
Setup generation the acknowledged progress was produced under;
receivers discard progress from a stale generation.

cover_path.description: Service-scoped artwork identity (cover path, not server URL).

description.description:
Episode synopsis/description, when the catalog carries one. Used by
Home's hero detail for Audiobookshelf rows.

is_finished.description:
Mirrors Audiobookshelf `is_finished` (distinct from played state
persisted here). Defaulted for backward compat.

position_ticks.description: Playback position in ticks. Zero means start from the beginning.

pub_date_secs.description: Publish time in Unix seconds, when available from the catalog.

build_id.description:
Build identity of the sending binary (design D3): the git short SHA
plus `-dirty` when the tree was dirty at build time. `#[serde(default)]`
keeps the field additive: a peer that predates it decodes an empty
value and is ignored by `PeerBuild::Any` handshakes.

control_token.description: Control credential used only when the peer advertises `control-auth`.

swap_token.description:
One-shot swap token carried only by a Client the Owner itself started
for a Pin swap. `None` for every Client the user started.

oneOf.description:
The daemon is shutting down deliberately (`mbv -q`, tray Quit).
Unlike `TakenOverByEmbyRemote`, this reason means the connection is
about to close, and it is not an Emby-authority notification.

EmbyArtistRef.description:
One `ArtistItems` name/ID pair from a music album/item payload: an
album-artist display name and the stable artist item ID it maps to.
This pair is mbv's only source of stable artist identity; IDs from an
`/Artists` listing never enter this field.

EmbyImageTags.description:
Declared image availability for one item (task 5.3, design D5): the
provider metadata the artwork policy reads to decide availability before
any image is fetched, so the chosen shape never changes when the image
arrives. These are Emby's default item-DTO members (not `Fields`-gated
properties), so parsing them needs no extra `Fields` request.

logo.description: `ImageTags.Logo`: an optional semantic logo decoration is declared available.

primary.description:
`ImageTags.Primary`: a primary (poster/square) image is declared
available.

series_backdrops.description: On episodes: the series' backdrop tags (`ParentBackdropImageTags`).

series_thumb.description:
On episodes: the series' thumb tag (`ParentThumbImageTag`, falling
back to `SeriesThumbImageTag`).

thumb.description: `ImageTags.Thumb`: a 16:9 landscape thumbnail is declared available.

artist_items.description:
`ArtistItems` name/ID pairs as returned on the payload, retained
verbatim. `Default` so legacy serialized queue items (which predate
the field) deserialize unchanged; serialized queue compatibility is
unchanged.

date_added.description:
Full ISO 8601 (not truncated to a date), so destination Latest markers
can compare it against the launch window at second precision.

image_tags.description:
Declared image availability (task 5.3): the Emby default-DTO image
tags the hero artwork policy reads to choose an artwork shape before
any image is fetched. `Default` so older payloads deserialize
unchanged.

studios.description:
`Studios[].Name`: the production studios — a series' network (NBC,
BBC, Netflix).

track_artist.description:
The track-level artist from the payload's `Artists` list (first
entry), kept distinct from `artist` (the album artist) so per-track
surfaces can prefer the individual artist. `Default` so legacy
serialized queue items (which predate the field) deserialize
unchanged; serialized queue compatibility is unchanged.

feed_id.description:
Stable feed identity for the keyed feed-entry state store (#492).
Set to the normalized subscription URL at fetch time. `None` means
the entry cannot address the store (legacy or identity-less) and
playback falls through to stateless behavior.

feed_kind.description:
Subscription's `FeedKind` carried into the queued snapshot. Canonical
media kind when enclosure MIME is absent or unrecognized; enclosure MIME
refines it when recognized. `None` means unknown — legacy
persisted/wire data that predates this field.

played.description:
Whether the entry has been played to completion (known-runtime EOF
or stop ≥ 95%). Played entries with position zero replay from start.

position_ticks.description:
Playback position in ticks. Zero means start from the beginning
(or the entry was marked played with position reset).

pub_date_secs.description:
Publish time in unix seconds UTC (RSS `pubDate` / Atom
`published`/`updated`), for the "All" group's newest-first sort.
Missing dates sort last. `#[serde(default)]` keeps old
`queue_state.json` files (pre-#471) loading.

FeedKind.description:
Media kind of a feed subscription, declared by the user in
`[[feeds]]` config entries. The stored kind is the default for the
subscription; per-entry kind can be refined from the enclosure MIME
at parse time (#471). Not currently used for routing — only for
display and future refinement (#472).

ItemId.description: Emby item identifier (movies, episodes, albums, tracks).

OutputConnection.description: Connection state of the Owner's remote playback output.

OutputState.description:
The Owner's active playback output, carried by `CtrlEvent::PlaybackOutput`
on cold seed and on every change (design D3). Slot, position, and pause
state keep travelling on `UnifiedQueueState` and `StatusOnly`, which have
no output-specific shape.

oneOf.description:
`audio_only` is the Session's own view of what it can play, and
`now_playing` is content that the Owner did not load.
mbv observed mpv's `PlaybackRestart` event for this generation.

estimated_remaining_ms.description:
Approximate time until the configured local estimate expires. Only
present for `OutputBuffering`; it is not an observed downstream value.

run_identity.description:
Identity of the Playback run that observed this stop: the owner
submission generation at event construction time.

slot_id.description:
Owner-assigned identity of the occurrence that stopped, or `None`
for teardown/error synthetics raised with no live queue slot
(spawn failure, panic, daemon disconnect). Resolved from the
Playback run's mpv-local position before the event leaves the run
(design D2). `#[serde(default)]` so a pre-change peer's
index-shaped `Stopped` still decodes (to `None`).

oneOf.description:
mpv advanced to (or was jumped to) an occurrence. Names the
owner-assigned slot identity, never an ordinal.

transition.description:
Present only when this observation settles a dispatched `JumpTo`
transition (design D4): `(request_id, generation)` of that
request. `None` for natural advancement. Bare-mode dispatch
populates this in Section 3; today it is always `None`.

oneOf.description: Emitted after the player confirms its paused property transition.

mpv's `PlaybackRestart` event. This confirms mbv's player output
boundary, not sound at a downstream pipe consumer.

run_identity.description:
Identity of the Playback run that observed this completion: the
owner submission generation at event construction time.

slot_id.description: Owner-assigned identity of the completed occurrence (design D7).

oneOf.description:
Rust identifier renamed from `PlaylistNextUp` (see #104); the wire tag
is pinned via `serde(rename)` so daemon/TUI processes at different
versions during an upgrade still speak the same JSON tag. `PlayerEvent`
has no `WireCommand`-style adapter (unlike `PlayerCommand`, see #81),
so this pin lives directly on the variant.
Look-ahead hint for the *next* occurrence, not an address of an
existing one: `next_idx` stays ordinal (it is only ever read to peek
the upcoming item for the Next-Up card, never to mutate or activate a
slot), per the presentation-coordinate carve-out in the stable-slot
spec rule.

Emitted by `RemotePlayer` when a `UnifiedQueueState` arrives so App can
sync the full canonical queue (tagged `QueueItems`, slot identity, active
slot, revision) without decomposing into legacy Emby-only shapes.
Result of an owner-authoritative queue operation.
Chapter API: playback entered the intro window.
Chapter API: playback passed `IntroEnd` (or track changed).
Chapter API: user clicked the "Skip Intro" button in MPV.
mpv exited on its own (user pressed q inside mpv, or mpv crashed).

Emitted when a Player owner cannot act on a command, including local
slot-addressed commands and daemon ctrl-socket commands. The reason
string is owner-computed and shown to the user as-is.

Correlated lifecycle update for a guarded direct-daemon playback
intent. The confirmed `PlayerStatus` remains authoritative separately.

Direct-daemon pipe startup status; absent for local, Emby-attached,
and non-pipe playback routes.

Emitted by `RemotePlayer` when the daemon intentionally disconnects this
ctrl client (actual connection close, not an authority-change notification).

Emitted by `RemotePlayer` when the daemon sends a `Disconnected` notification
for Emby remote authority takeover. Unlike `RemoteDisconnected`, this is
an authority-change notification — the connection stays open.

Emitted by `RemotePlayer` when its connection closes after the daemon
announced a deliberate shutdown (`DisconnectReason::DaemonShutdown`).
Unlike `RemoteDisconnected`, this is not a crash: the client SHALL
print one line, restore the terminal, and exit rather than offer
recovery.

Emitted when an external tool modifies mpv's playlist outside of mbv's
control (e.g. by writing to the mpv IPC socket), causing mbv's queue
mirror to become stale. The detail describes what was detected. The UI
shows this as a warning toast.

The Owner asks this Client to prepare for a Pin swap: save the launch
snapshot now and answer `CtrlCmd::SwapPrepared` (tray-pin-swap design
D2). Sent only to a Client that advertised `pin-swap`.

The Owner tells this Client to exit now as swapped out: skip the
launch-state save and the coordinated shutdown request (tray-pin-swap
design D2/D6). Sent only to a Client that advertised `pin-swap`.

Emitted by `RemotePlayer` when the daemon sends redacted Audiobookshelf
progress. Dormant: delivered for a future browse-reconciliation
consumer, but nothing applies it to queue or browse state yet.

Book-shaped counterpart to `AudiobookshelfProgress`; keyed by
`library_item_id` only.

The Owner's active playback output, forwarded from
`CtrlEvent::PlaybackOutput` (cast-owner-output design D3/D13). Sent on
cold seed and on every output change, only to peers that negotiated
`playback-output`; the TUI reads it for the connection mark, the output
indicator, and the idle keep-panel rule.

art_album_id.description:
Album id for the current track, when it's a grouped audio track
(mirrors the `Audio` + non-empty `album_id` grouping the
queue card already uses in `crates/mbv-render/src/components/card.rs`, so the
same disk-cache entry a browsed album card populated can be reused
here). Empty when not applicable.

art_item_id.description:
Id of the current track's Emby item, used by the root `mbv` crate to
resolve `mpris:artUrl` against the on-disk image cache. Deliberately
NOT a ready-made URL: `mbv-core` has no access to the disk cache
(that lives in the root crate's `config` module) and, per #158's
recorded triage decision, must never build a token-bearing Emby URL
as a fallback. See `mbv-desktop::mpris::resolve_art_url`.

sequence_generation.description: Monotonic identity for the owner's current queue submission.

QueueOpId.description: Identity correlating one Client queue operation with its owner's answer.

ServiceKind.description:
Singleton Service kind identifier. Each variant represents exactly one
configured instance of that Service within mbv.

oneOf.description:
Reserved; not yet implemented. Added now to establish the pattern
and the per-Service secret path. No Audiobookshelf auth, browsing,
playback, or credential logic is introduced here.

SessionNowPlaying.description:
Content that an Emby Session plays but the Owner did not load
(emby-session-owner-output design D3): the device's own item. The Owner
sends it only when that item changes, not on every `StatusOnly` broadcast.

logo_tag.description:
The item's own logo image tag. An episode's logo lives on its series
and is keyed by the series id alone, so it needs no tag.

TransitionSummary.description:
Summary of a pending playback transition carried in the owner snapshot.
Kept independent of internal queue types — the target slot is a raw u64,
matching `UnifiedQueueSlot::slot_id`.

UnifiedQueueSlot.description:
One slot in the unified queue representation.  The `slot_id` is the
stable runtime identity of the occurrence (not the item's content ID).

UnifiedQueueStateData.description: Full queue state exchanged between unified-queue-capable peers.

in_flight_transition.description:
Transition dispatched to the Playback run and awaiting observation.
`None` when no transition is in flight.

lineage.description: Owner-minted identity for the current whole-queue replacement lineage.

queued_latest_transition.description:
Newest queued transition held back behind the in-flight one. `None`
when nothing is queued.

revision.description: Owner-local diagnostic value; clients never compare this across processes.

oneOf.description:
A command the daemon received over the ctrl socket was not acted on;
the payload is a human-readable, server-computed reason. Generic by
design so future rejection reasons (not just audio-only mode) can
reuse it — see #90.

Observed pipe-startup progress for a direct daemon client. The daemon
owns this status; it never represents downstream audibility.

The daemon accepted a coordinated shutdown request after durably
persisting its authoritative queue.

The daemon rejected a coordinated shutdown request. The reason
indicates why (e.g. TCP transport, persistence failure).

Owner to the Pin-swap target: save launch state now, then acknowledge
with `CtrlCmd::SwapPrepared`.
Owner to the replaced Pin-swap target: exit now as swapped out.
The Owner accepted an Owner action (`CtrlCmd::RunOwnerAction`).

The Owner refused an Owner action; the payload is a human-readable,
Owner-computed reason.

Full item-generic queue state.  Sent on initial connection and
after every queue mutation.
Result of one correlated owner queue operation.

Redacted, provider-qualified Audiobookshelf progress. Sent only to
peers advertising `abs-progress`. See `AudiobookshelfProgressEvent`
for the field-level redaction contract this event upholds.

Redacted, provider-qualified Audiobookshelf book progress. Sent only to
peers advertising `abs-book-progress`. Keyed by `library_item_id` only,
so it can never be matched against an episode-shaped event.

The Owner's active playback output, sent on cold seed and on every
change to peers advertising `playback-output` (cast-owner-output
design D3). Slot, position, and pause state stay on
`UnifiedQueueState` and `StatusOnly`.
